summary: Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, reporting three items: entry into Amendment No. 3 to its Receivables Financing Agreement (RFA), which extends the securitization facility's termination date to May 4, 2029, increases the facility limit from $500 million to $600 million, and removes a 10-basis-point credit spread adjustment; issuance of a press release on May 7, 2026, covering Q1 2026 financial results; and disclosure of a routine director or officer departure. The RFA amendment is a routine credit facility modification, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic events are present. This filing is a routine operational update with no M&A, activist, or restructuring implications.
